app.title: Mframapa AI
app.tagline: Ukubekwa Umoya nge-AI Ngexesha Lokwenyani e-Afrika
error.outside_africa: Uxolo, i-Mframapa AI igubungela amazwe ase-Afrika kuphela.
error.generic: Ayikwazi ukufumana idolophu. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
card.share_text: Umgangatho womoya kwi-{{city}}: {{pm25}} µg/m³ ({{category}}) ngeMframapa AI
advice.moderate: Izinga eliphakathi. Abantu abazwelayo kumele banciphe ukuchatshazelwa.
advice.sensitive: Ayifanelanga amaqela azwelayo. Nxiba isifonyo ukuba kuyafuneka.
insight.good: Umoyaucocekile ngenxa yokuhamba kakuhle komoya. Kukhuselekile kuyo yonke imisebenzi.
insight.moderate: Ukuqokelelana amasuntswana okuncinci. Iimeko zamkelekile kubantu abaninzi.
insight.sensitive: Amasuntswana aphakamileyo mhlawumbi aphuma kwiindawo ezikufutshane. Amaqela abuthathaka makalumke.
insight.unhealthy: Uzinzo lamasuntswana aphezulu luqatshelwe. Oku kubonisa imithombo yokutshisa yendawo.
insight.hazardous: Umgangatho womoya oyingozi. Hlala ngaphakathi kwaye ucoce umoya ukuba kunokwenzeka.
about.title: Malunga ne-Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: I-Mframapa AI iqikelela i-PM2.5 imihla ngemihla kumazwe angama-54 ase-Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Amadolophu amaninzi ase-Afrika awanayo izixhobo zokubeka umoya. Sivalela esi sikhewu.
about.how.step1.title: Ii-Satellite Njengezisensa
about.how.step1.desc: Ukusebenzisa idatha ye-ESA Sentinel-5P ne-NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Ukulungiswa Komhlaba
about.how.step2.desc: Imodeli iqeqeshwe kwizikhululo ezingama-398 kumazwe angama-29.
about.how.step3.title: Ukuqikelela Kwelizwekazi
about.how.step3.desc: Imodeli ye-XGBoost iqikelela i-PM2.5 kweyiphi na indawo yase-Afrika.
about.limit.gap_desc: Ukudlula kwee-satellite imihla ngemihla kunokuphoswa ukuphakama okufutshane.
report.title: Xela Umoya
report.subtitle: Nikela kwidatha yoluntu.
pwa.home.subtitle: Umgangatho wesixeko okhawulezayo u-PM2.5 uhlola kunye namava emveliso yolwazi ngaphandle kweintanethi.
pwa.search.label: Khangela
pwa.search.offline: Imowudi yokungaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi — ibonisa uluhlu lwesixeko esigciniweyo
pwa.core.location_error: Ayikwazanga ukufumana indawo okuyo — khangela isignali yeGPS uze uzame kwakhona
pwa.core.location_permission: Ufikelelo lwendawo lwaliwe — nceda uvumele indawo ekuseto lwebrawuza yakho
pwa.core.africa_only: Le app ibandakanya izixeko zaseAfrika kuphela - cofa ngaphakathi kweAfrika
pwa.core.land_only: Cofa emhlabeni ukuze ufunde, hayi ulwandle
pwa.search.no_saved_message: Khangela kwaye uqhube itshekhi ukongeza izixeko zokufikelela ngokukhawuleza.
pwa.search.no_matches_message: Zama elinye igama lesixeko okanye igama elingundoqo lelizwe.
pwa.core.start_body: Siya kubuyisela ubume be-PM2.5 kwaye sihlaziye isishwankathelo sakho sedeshibhodi.
pwa.core.offline_message: Unxibelelwano lwemephu lulinganiselwe ngelixa ungaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi. Qhagamshela kwakhona ukuze ulande ufundo lwesixeko olutsha.
pwa.core.city_pack_message: Ukuvumelanisa uluhlu oluphezulu lwesixeko ukukhangela kunye nokusetyenziswa ngaphandle kweintanethi.
pwa.network.offline: Imo engasebenziyo: ibonisa idatha egciniweyo xa ikhona
pwa.network.online: Buyela kwi-intanethi: ukuhlaziya ngedatha yamva nje
pwa.onboarding.step1_body: Khangela nasiphi na isixeko sase-Afrika esixhaswayo kwaye ufumane ubume be-PM2.5 ngemizuzwana.
pwa.onboarding.step2_body: I-app igcina iitshekhi zakho zakutsha nje kwiimeko zoqhagamshelo oluphantsi.
pwa.onboarding.step3_body: Ungasebenzisa ukhetho lwesixeko ngesandla kwaye ugweme ukulandelela indawo rhoqo.
pwa.auth.subtitle: Sayina ungene ukuze ungqamanise umkhondo wesixeko sakho kunye nezilumkiso.
pwa.auth.reset_subtitle: Faka i-imeyile yakho kwaye siza kuthumela ikhonkco lokucwangcisa kwakhona.
pwa.auth.reset_sent: Ukuba i-akhawunti ikhona, ikhonkco lokuseta ngokutsha lithunyelwe.
pwa.auth.welcome_notification: Wamkelekile kwiMframapa. Ungaqalisa ukujonga iimeko zesixeko.
pwa.profile.title: Iprofayili
pwa.activity.empty_message: Iitshekhi zakho zamva nje kunye nezenzo zeakhawunti ziya kuvela apha.
pwa.notifications.empty_message: Uhlaziyo lwenkqubo kunye nezilumkiso ezibalulekileyo ziya kuvela apha.
